brief:
**THESIS STATUS:** WEAKENED

**ADJUSTED CONFIDENCE:** 65% (down from 97%)

**OVERNIGHT SUMMARY:** Global risk-off sentiment with broad equity selloff across all major indices. VIX spike to 21.4 (+1.8%) signals increased volatility expectations. US futures showing coordinated weakness with SPX down 0.38%.

**KEY DEVELOPMENTS:**
• European markets leading selloff (DAX -1.15%, Euro Stoxx -0.78%)
• Asian markets uniformly negative (Nikkei -0.73%, Shanghai -0.72%)
• VIX breakout above 21 threshold indicates fear regime activation
• Composite overnight signal flipped bearish (-0.16) vs bullish prediction
• GEX shows Call Wall resistance at 6775 (near our short strike)

**TRADE RECOMMENDATION STATUS:** HOLD WITH TIGHT STOPS

**TRADE NOTES:** 
Current SPX ~6797 vs our 680.85 breakeven presents 16-point buffer. Call Wall at 6775 creates natural resistance near our 705 short strike. Monitor for break below 6790 support - if breached, consider taking 50% loss rather than riding to zero.

**DAY AHEAD RISKS:**
• VIX above 21 suggests continued volatility expansion
• Pre-market weakness may accelerate on US open
• Put Wall support at 6700 is 97 points away (significant gap risk)
• Economic data releases could amplify directional moves

**DAY AHEAD OPPORTUNITIES:**
• Oversold bounce potential if selling exhausted at open
• GEX positioning suggests range-bound action between 6700-6775
• High IV environment may benefit option sellers if volatility contracts
• European weakness may not translate to US session given different catalysts
